'''Comaelle''' was a High Queen of [[Jaramide]].

== History ==
Comaelle reigned around {{ab|325}}. Her Counsel-Sister was [[Sereine dar Shamelle Motara]], who wrote ''Commentaries on the [[Karaethon Cycle]]'' during the reign of High Queen Comaelle.{{ref/book|4|1}}
